subject.title: [Feature]: Telegram Business Bot support (business_message / business_connection updates)

question: Should bundled Telegram support include Telegram Business personal-DM handling now, and what account-scoped `business_connection_id` authority model should it use?
rationale: The feature fits the Telegram plugin surface, but it grants OpenClaw access to Business-connected personal DMs and outbound Business-account authority after a prior implementation was closed for security and routing blockers.

options.title: Approve bounded bundled support
options.body: Implement this in the bundled Telegram plugin with per-account durable connection state, disconnect cleanup, Business-aware dedupe/sequencing, docs, tests, and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Require design first
options.body: Keep the tracker open and require a short maintainer design note for access control, persistence, and outbound authority before accepting another implementation.

options.title: Defer bundled support
options.body: Keep relay or proxy workarounds as the supported path until maintainers approve the Telegram Business security model or a plugin API seam.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded bundled support
recommendation.body: Implement this in the bundled Telegram plugin with per-account durable connection state, disconnect cleanup, Business-aware dedupe/sequencing, docs, tests, and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has recent Telegram handler/update history and closed the prior implementation pending Telegram-owner direction.
